opening.argument: The video is presented as entertainment and public awareness: its description states, “I make these videos in hopes of entertaining people but also to raise awareness,” and explains, “In this video I call some Microsoft tech support scammers and IRS scammers.” The recorded exchanges therefore function as scambaiting and exposure of alleged callers who are described as tricking people into paying money, rather than as a solicitation or endorsement by the creator. The only closing viewer request is to like the video, made after the calls: “if you guys enjoyed the video I want to see more buddy make sure to slap that like button.” That ordinary engagement request is not connected to payment, investment, credential submission, or another financial offer.
